Ändern or Sich Ändern? German B1 Verb-Pattern Practice

Compare etwas ändern with sich ändern in German. Practise changing an object and changes to the subject with translated examples and explained answers.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Understand the difference

Etwas ändern means changing something: Wir ändern den Plan. Sich ändern means changing or becoming different, with the changing thing as subject: Der Plan ändert sich. The reflexive pronoun agrees with the subject: ich ändere mich, wir ändern uns. Include it when the reflexive pattern is intended.

Common mistake to avoid

Der Plan ändert sich does not mean the plan deliberately edits something else. The subject is what becomes different; in Wir ändern den Plan, the plan is the object.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Compare the meaning and sentence pattern, rather than choosing by English translation alone.

Worked example 1Die Redaktion ändert den letzten Absatz.The editorial team changes the final paragraph.
Worked example 2Die Stimmung ändert sich nach dem Gespräch.The mood changes after the conversation.
Worked example 3Ich ändere meine Adresse im Entwurf.I change my address in the draft.
Worked example 4Unsere Gewohnheiten ändern sich mit der Zeit.Our habits change over time.

Practice: choose the right word

Complete the gap with the present-tense form of ändern or sich ändern. Include the reflexive pronoun inside the gap when the subject itself changes. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Ich ___ den Text an zwei Stellen. (edit an object)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: ändere

Den Text is the object; the non-reflexive form is ändere.

Question 2. Ich ___ mit den Jahren. (become different myself)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: ändere mich

The subject changes, so include the ich reflexive pronoun mich.

Question 3. Die Temperatur ___ über Nacht. (it becomes different)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: ändert sich

The singular subject is what changes, requiring ändert sich.

Question 4. Wir ___ die Reihenfolge der Kapitel. (change an object)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: ändern

Wir changes the direct object die Reihenfolge; no reflexive pronoun is needed.

Use it in your own sentence

Describe actively changing a plan and the weather changing by itself.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Wir ändern den Plan, weil sich das Wetter ändert.

Check your wording: The reflexive form makes the changing thing the subject.

What to practise next

Write a new context for each word. Explain which meaning or object pattern makes your choice natural; some contexts allow both.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
